visualCharacteristics.purpose: Vertical list of qualification steps, each a small icon beside its copy
visualCharacteristics.layout: One step per row; fixed-width icon column (numbered circle or checkmark image) left of the step copy
visualCharacteristics.notes: The list may be split into several block instances on one page (e.g. steps 1-2, then a table block, then a final step).

contentPattern.structure: one row per step: cell 1 icon image (or :icon:), cell 2 step copy (paragraphs, links, italic note). The icon cell may be omitted

usage: How-to-qualify or how-it-works step lists on offer pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for icon-beside-text step or checklist rows. For grids of cards use cards or cards-product.
